title: What Space Really Does to Your Body
hook: Your body would not explode in space.
script: Your body would not explode in space. It would not freeze solid either, whatever the movies show. You would stay awake for about 15 seconds. So why does that last so long, with nothing to breathe out there? Because the oxygen already in your blood keeps your brain running until it drains away through your lungs. And what happens to the water in your body? It starts to boil, even at normal body temperature. NASA once tested this on a person in a vacuum chamber. He felt the saliva on his tongue start to bubble. Then he blacked out, and the chamber was repressurised.
